subject: x1 Pool-capability guard miss: reproduce why a pooled implementation task reached the read-only Researcher (findings only)
verdict: root cause identified and reproduced; no fix applied

rootCause.summary: The guard tests `member.toolDeny`, but the object the scheduler hands it is the TEAM member record, which has no such field; the deny list lives in the roster PROFILE data and is consumed only at spawn (toolFilter). With `member.toolDeny === undefined`, `new Set(member?.toolDeny ?? [])` is empty, `taskCapabilityGap` returns [], and the pooled implementation task is delivered.
rootCause.candidate: b/e — a capability flag whose value is applied at spawn and read from a different source than the scheduler's member record

ruledOut.a_guard_only_repair: taskCapabilityNeed lists 'implementation' explicitly (scheduler.js:235); repro shape A withholds an implementation task
ruledOut.c_bypass_path: the guard IS the entry for unassigned tasks (scheduler.js:518-528) and filters assignee===undefined (:289)
ruledOut.d_logs_but_returns: the withhold branch calls withhold(...) then continue (:291-293)
